Title: User Registration - Customer Account Creation
Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page | 2. Fill in required fields (name email password phone) | 3. Select 'Customer' role | 4. Click 'Create account' button | 5. Verify redirect to home page
Test Data: Name: John Doe, Email: john.doe@example.com, Password: Test123!, Phone: 555-1234, Role: Customer
Expected Result: User account is created successfully with customer role. JWT token is issued. User is redirected to home page with authenticated session.

Title: User Registration - Dealer Account Creation
Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page | 2. Fill in required fields (name email password phone) | 3. Select 'Dealer' role | 4. Enter dealer code | 5. Click 'Create account' button | 6. Verify redirect to home page
Test Data: Name: Jane Smith, Email: jane.smith@dealer.com, Password: Dealer123!, Phone: 555-5678, Role: Dealer, DealerCode: DEAL001
Expected Result: Dealer account is created with dealer code. User can access dealer dashboard. JWT token issued.

Title: User Registration - Admin Account Creation
Steps: 1. Navigate to registration page | 2. Fill in required fields (name email password phone) | 3. Select 'Admin' role | 4. Click 'Create account' button | 5. Verify redirect to home page
Test Data: Name: Admin User, Email: admin@example.com, Password: Admin123!, Phone: 555-9999, Role: Admin
Expected Result: Admin account is created successfully. User has access to admin dashboard and all admin privileges.

Title: User Login - Valid Credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page | 2. Enter valid email and password | 3. Click 'Sign in' button | 4. Verify redirect to previous page or home
Expected Result: User is authenticated successfully. JWT token is stored securely. User is redirected with access to protected routes.

Title: Admin Dashboard - View System Metrics
Steps: 1. Navigate to admin dashboard | 2. View overview tab | 3. Verify metrics cards display | 4. Check recent activity feed
Test Data: Admin user with valid JWT token
Expected Result: Dashboard displays total users (active count) total vehicles (available count) total bookings (pending count) test drives and loan applications. Recent activity shows last 10 audit log entries.

Title: Admin Dashboard - User Management
Steps: 1. Navigate to admin dashboard | 2. Click 'users' tab | 3. Search for specific user | 4. Filter by role | 5. Toggle user status (activate/deactivate) | 6. Verify audit log created
Expected Result: Admin can view all users with pagination. Search filters users by name/email. Role filter works correctly. User status toggle updates database and creates audit log entry.

Title: Admin Dashboard - Vehicle Management
Steps: 1. Navigate to admin dashboard | 2. Click 'vehicles' tab | 3. Search for vehicle by make/model/VIN | 4. Filter by status | 5. Delete a vehicle | 6. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: Admin can view all vehicles across all dealers. Search and filters work correctly. Delete action removes vehicle and creates audit log. Confirmation dialog prevents accidental deletion.

Title: Admin Dashboard - Booking Management
Steps: 1. Navigate to admin dashboard | 2. Click 'bookings' tab | 3. Filter by status | 4. Update booking status from pending to confirmed | 5. Verify audit log
Expected Result: Admin can view all bookings with user and vehicle details. Status filter works. Status updates are persisted and audit logged. Booking status transitions (pending→confirmed→completed) work correctly.

Title: Customer Vehicle Registration
Steps: 1. Navigate to vehicle registration form | 2. Fill in vehicle details (make model year VIN) | 3. Add optional details (mileage color condition) | 4. Submit form | 5. Verify vehicle appears in customer's list
Test Data: Make: Honda, Model: Civic, Year: 2020, VIN: 1HGBH41JXMN109186, Mileage: 45000, Color: Blue, Condition: good
Expected Result: Vehicle is registered successfully and linked to customer account. Audit log entry created. Vehicle appears in customer's vehicle list with all entered details.

Title: Vehicle Booking with Real-time Availability Check
Preconditions: Customer logged in and vehicle available
Steps: 1. Browse inventory page | 2. Select available vehicle | 3. Check availability endpoint shows stock > 0 | 4. Create booking | 5. Verify transaction updates stock | 6. Check audit log
Expected Result: Availability check returns isAvailable: true. Booking creation uses database transaction. Stock quantity decrements by 1. If stock reaches 0 status changes to reserved. Audit log records booking creation with vehicle and price details.

Title: Complete User Journey - Registration to Booking
Steps: 1. Register new customer account | 2. Login with credentials | 3. Browse vehicle inventory | 4. Check vehicle availability | 5. Create booking for available vehicle | 6. View booking in 'My Bookings' | 7. Admin views booking in admin dashboard | 8. Verify audit logs for all actions
Test Data: Complete user registration and booking data
Expected Result: End-to-end flow completes successfully. User registration creates account. Login authenticates user. Vehicle booking creates reservation with transaction. Stock updates correctly. All actions appear in audit logs. Admin can view and manage the booking.

Title: Admin Complete Workflow
Preconditions: Admin account and test data exist
Steps: 1. Admin logs in | 2. Views system metrics on overview | 3. Searches and filters users | 4. Deactivates a test user | 5. Views vehicles and filters by dealer | 6. Reviews pending bookings | 7. Confirms a booking | 8. Views audit logs | 9. Verifies all actions logged
Test Data: Admin credentials and existing test data
Expected Result: Admin can perform all management tasks. Each action creates appropriate audit log entry. Filters and search work across all tabs. Status updates persist correctly. Audit logs show complete history with user action entity and timestamp.

Title: Dealer Inventory Management to Customer Booking
Steps: 1. Dealer logs in | 2. Adds new vehicle to inventory | 3. Customer logs in | 4. Browses inventory and sees dealer's vehicle | 5. Checks availability (shows available) | 6. Creates booking | 7. Dealer views booking in their dashboard | 8. Admin sees audit logs for vehicle creation and booking
Test Data: Dealer code: DEAL001 Vehicle and booking data
Expected Result: Dealer can add vehicles with their dealer code. Vehicle appears in public inventory. Availability check works. Customer can book. Dealer sees bookings for their vehicles only. Admin sees all audit logs for the complete flow.

Title: User Registration - Duplicate Email
Steps: 1. Attempt to register with existing email | 2. Submit form | 3. Verify error message
Expected Result: Registration fails with error 'Email already registered'. Status code 400 returned. No user account created. Form displays error message to user.

Title: Vehicle Booking - Out of Stock
Steps: 1. Attempt to check availability for out-of-stock vehicle | 2. Attempt to create booking | 3. Verify error
Expected Result: Availability check returns isAvailable: false. Booking creation fails with error 'Vehicle is not available for booking'. Transaction is rolled back. No stock changes occur. Status code 400 returned.

Title: Customer Vehicle Registration - Duplicate VIN
Preconditions: VIN already exists in CustomerVehicle collection
Steps: 1. Attempt to register vehicle with existing VIN | 2. Submit form | 3. Verify error
Expected Result: Registration fails with error 'Vehicle with this VIN already registered'. Status code 400. No duplicate vehicle created. MongoDB unique index prevents duplicate VINs.

Title: Admin User Management - Delete Non-existent User
Steps: 1. Navigate to users tab | 2. Attempt to delete user with invalid/deleted ID | 3. Verify error handling
Expected Result: Delete operation returns 404 error. No database changes occur. Error message displayed. Audit log records failed attempt if user was authenticated.

Title: Booking Concurrent Requests - Race Condition
Preconditions: Vehicle with stockQuantity: 1 and multiple users attempting to book
Steps: 1. Simulate concurrent booking requests for same vehicle | 2. Verify transaction isolation | 3. Check only one booking succeeds | 4. Other requests fail with availability error
Test Data: Two simultaneous POST requests to /api/bookings with same vehicleId
Expected Result: MongoDB transaction ensures only one booking succeeds. First transaction commits and decrements stock. Second transaction fails with 'Vehicle is not available'. No overselling occurs due to transaction isolation.

Title: User Login - Role-Based Redirect
Steps: 1. Login as customer | 2. Verify access to customer features | 3. Login as dealer | 4. Verify access to dealer dashboard | 5. Login as admin | 6. Verify access to admin dashboard
Expected Result: Each role sees appropriate navigation links. Customer sees bookings and test drives. Dealer sees 'My Inventory'. Admin sees 'Admin Dashboard'. Role-based authorization enforced on both frontend and backend.

Title: Vehicle Availability Check - Real-time Updates
Preconditions: Vehicle exists with varying stock levels
Steps: 1. Check availability for vehicle with stock > 1 | 2. Create booking | 3. Check availability again | 4. Verify stock decremented
Expected Result: First availability check returns stockQuantity: 5 isAvailable: true. After booking stockQuantity: 4 isAvailable: true. Real-time availability accurately reflects current database state.

Title: Admin Audit Logs - Filter and Search
Steps: 1. Navigate to audit logs tab | 2. Filter by action type | 3. Filter by entity type | 4. Filter by date range | 5. Verify filtered results
Test Data: Action: create_booking EntityType: booking Date range: last 7 days
Expected Result: Audit logs filter correctly by action entity type and date range. Pagination works for large result sets (limit 100 per page). Logs show timestamp user action entity and status for each entry.

Title: Customer Vehicle Update - Modify Details
Steps: 1. Navigate to customer vehicle list | 2. Select vehicle | 3. Update mileage and condition | 4. Save changes | 5. Verify audit log
Expected Result: Vehicle details update successfully. Changes persist in database. Audit log created with action: update_customer_vehicle showing changed fields. Only vehicle owner can update their vehicles.

Title: User Login - Invalid Credentials
Steps: 1. Navigate to login page | 2. Enter valid email but incorrect password | 3. Attempt login | 4. Verify error
Expected Result: Login fails with error 'Invalid email or password'. Status code 401. No token issued. Error message does not reveal whether email exists (security best practice).

Title: User Login - Inactive Account
Steps: 1. Attempt to login with inactive account credentials | 2. Verify error message
Expected Result: Login fails with error 'Account is inactive'. Status code 403. No token issued even though credentials are correct. User cannot authenticate with inactive account.

Title: Admin Access - Non-Admin User
Preconditions: Customer or dealer user logged in
Steps: 1. Customer/dealer attempts to access /api/admin/metrics | 2. Verify authorization error | 3. Attempt to access admin dashboard page | 4. Verify frontend protection
Expected Result: Backend returns 403 Forbidden error. Frontend ProtectedRoute component prevents access to admin dashboard. Navigation does not show admin links for non-admin users. Authorization middleware blocks all /api/admin/* endpoints.

Title: Booking Creation - Missing Authentication
Steps: 1. Attempt to POST to /api/bookings without Authorization header | 2. Verify authentication error
Expected Result: Request fails with 401 Unauthorized error. Error message: 'Authentication required'. No booking created. Authenticate middleware blocks unauthenticated requests.

Title: Vehicle Registration - Invalid VIN Format
Steps: 1. Attempt to create vehicle with invalid VIN | 2. Submit form | 3. Verify validation error
Test Data: VIN: INVALID (not meeting format requirements), Make: Toyota, Model: Camry
Expected Result: Mongoose validation fails. Error indicates VIN requirements. Status code 400. No vehicle created. Frontend should validate VIN format before submission.

Title: Customer Vehicle Access - Unauthorized User
Preconditions: Two customer users exist each with vehicles
Steps: 1. Customer A attempts to access Customer B's vehicle endpoint | 2. Verify authorization error | 3. Attempt to update or delete Customer B's vehicle
Expected Result: Request returns 404 error (not found rather than forbidden to avoid information disclosure). Customer can only access their own vehicles. ownerId query filter prevents unauthorized access.

Title: Admin User Delete - Self-deletion
Steps: 1. Admin attempts to delete their own account | 2. Verify error or warning
Test Data: Admin user ID = logged in user ID
Expected Result: System should prevent admin self-deletion or show warning. If allowed account is deleted but admin loses access. Best practice: require at least one admin account or prevent self-deletion.

Title: Booking Update - Dealer Cannot Cancel Customer Booking
Preconditions: Dealer and customer with booking exist
Steps: 1. Dealer attempts to update status of customer booking to cancelled | 2. Verify authorization check
Test Data: Dealer JWT booking belongs to customer for dealer's vehicle
Expected Result: Authorization check allows dealer to view bookings for their vehicles but restricts status changes that should be customer-initiated. Role-based business logic enforced.
